doors.note: One static read (HTTP 200, 149 KB). Payload is <script id="__NEXT_DATA__"> -> props.pageProps: upcomingEvents=[] (length 0), upcomingEventsTotal=0, hasMoreUpcoming=false, upcomingEventsFailed=false, collections=[] (collectionsTotal 0). organizer.name "Bears of London Meet-ups", organizer.metrics: followers 24, hostingYears "3 years", totalEvents 9, attendeesHosted 61. organizer.profilePageUrl https://www.eventbrite.co.uk/o/bears-of-london-meet-ups-64998384913.

One headless Chrome --dump-dom (virtual-time-budget 15s). The Upcoming tab renders the literal empty state "Nothing planned right now Follow this organizer to stay in the loop for future plans" under the header "followers 24 • hosting on Eventbrite 3 years • total events 9 • total attendees 61". No /e/ event link anywhere in the DOM.
Organizer and event pages are permitted; the disallowed paths are feeds, checkout and tracking-parameter URLs.

recon.notes: Added 2026-09-29 at the owner's request, who named three channels as one organisation: instagram.com/bearsoflondon_network, eventbrite.com/o/64998384913 and a Facebook group (facebook.com/share/g/19hST5FKTP/). Instagram and Facebook are behind a login and were not requested. The Eventbrite profile's own socials name instagram.com/bearsoflondon_meetups (organizer.socials.website) and facebook.com/profile.php?id=102095092901119 — an earlier handle than the one the owner gave. Nine events in three years: this door is quiet most of the time, and costs one request per run.

coverage.basis: Two independent doors agree the organizer currently publishes zero upcoming events: the static __NEXT_DATA__ payload (upcomingEventsTotal 0, hasMoreUpcoming false, upcomingEvents []) and a headless-Chrome render of the same page showing the literal empty state "Nothing planned right now". The organizer has 9 lifetime events; the Past tab is client-fetched, so past listings are counted, not enumerated.

traps.label: followers 24 • hosting on Eventbrite 3 years • total events 9 • total attendees 61
traps.why: Organizer profile header with lifetime metrics; its counts are not events and not dates. Only visible in the rendered DOM.

traps.why: The rendered Upcoming tab's empty-state copy: the positive signal that the organizer publishes nothing. It must never be read as an event or as a fetch failure (the page is HTTP 200 and upcomingEventsFailed is false).

openQuestions.q: The group announces on Instagram and in a Facebook group, both behind a login; only ticketed meet-ups reach Eventbrite (9 in 3 years). Events announced on the social channels alone cannot be read by the scraper.
